bot.title: About StoreDirectoryBot
bot.intro: We index publicly available Shopify storefronts so people can research the market. Here is exactly what we do and do not do.
bot.do1: Reads public certificate transparency logs to find newly registered domains.
bot.do3: Sends at most one request per second to any single store.
bot.do4: Identifies itself honestly in the User-Agent and honours robots.txt.
bot.do5: Backs off for 24 hours from any host that returns 429 or 503.
bot.dont1: Never estimates or displays revenue, sales counts or earnings.
bot.dont2: Never queries inventory quantity endpoints such as cart/add.js.
bot.dont3: Never collects personal data — no owner names, emails or phone numbers.
bot.dont4: Never bypasses logins, captchas or IP blocks, and never rotates proxies.
bot.dont5: Never copies product images to our servers; we hotlink or keep only a hash.
bot.removalBody: If you own a store listed here and want it removed, send the domain below. Requests are processed within 7 days and the store disappears from every page and API response.
bot.success: Request received. It will be processed within 7 days.
bot.error: Could not send the request. Please try again.
bot.rateLimited: Too many requests. Please try again later.
